The system even flagged duplicate queries with no results. I don't have current menus, prices, hours, or availability, so I can't hand you three "verified" picks.

What I can offer are three independent, veg friendly Chicago spots that are commonly cited for this exact request. Please treat these as leads to confirm, not confirmed reservations:

The Berghoff (17 W Adams St), historic, family owned, inside the Loop. Vegetarian entrees in the $15, 25 range and a classic Chicago feel. Call ahead to check hours and whether they take a party of four at 7:30.

The Dearborn (116 N Dearborn St), independent Loop tavern with a dedicated vegetarian section, mains roughly $20, 35, and a strong vibe for a group dinner. Confirm the menu and table availability.

The Chicago Diner (233 W Erie St, River North), fully vegetarian comfort food, entrees around $13, 20, about a 15 minute walk from the Loop. It has a second location in Lakeview, but it's independently owned, not a national chain.

Blocker: none of these are verified against tomorrow's hours, prices, or reservations. If you can tell me your exact starting point in the Loop, I can retry the search anchored to that location, but the current search tooling is returning junk results.
